 Community Watchlist Portfolio Search stocks, sectors, indices or pages News Energy Quick read Govt slashes petrol, diesel prices by Rs3
 Mettis Global • 19 Nov 2026, 7:24 AM PKT • 1 min read 
 ENG اردو A- A+ Add as preferred source on Google X f Mettis Global reported that petrol and high-speed diesel prices each fell by Rs3 per litre from November 19, 2026, following a revision by the Oil and Gas Regulatory Authority (OGRA). Petrol is now priced at Rs322 per litre, down from Rs325, while high-speed diesel costs Rs355 per litre, compared with Rs358 previously.
 The revised ex-depot rates were set under the petroleum pricing mechanism approved by the federal government. The change applies from November 19, 2026, and covers both products listed in the notification. The announcement provides updated official prices for consumers and businesses that use petrol or diesel, and is relevant to Pakistan’s fuel market and oil and gas marketing sector.
 At a glance
 Petrol fell by Rs3 per litre to Rs322 from November 19, 2026.
 High-speed diesel dropped by Rs3 per litre to Rs355.
